caption: The drawing shows a rectangular, domed-lid chest with a metal handle on top and a metal latch at the front center. The main body of the chest is painted brown, with visible wear and areas of faded or chipped paint. Decorative elements include a band near the top featuring a floral design composed of red flowers and green leaves on a pale background. Below this band, there is a swag motif in red and gold that drapes along the front and sides. The chest sits against a plain, light background, and there is a small, faint signature or text located near the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Toleware Box
